name: Packages Agent
summary: The packages/agent module contains two generations of agent execution: a legacy runtime in src/ (agent loop, Agent class) and a newer harness runtime in src/harness/ with durable session storage (memory, JSONL, v3 migration), a lane-based durable operation model, compaction/branch summarization, file tools (read/write/edit/bash) and telemetry schemas. A separate pico3 harness under src/harness/pico3/ implements a task-kind scheduler with kinds (generation/tool/post-tools/collapse/job) over a Storage interface, backed by MemoryStorage or JsonlStorage, plus a chord view bridge. The module also has extensive benchmarks, conformance tests, and docs under docs/ and benchmark/.
keyPoints: Two distinct runtimes: a legacy agent loop (src/agent-loop.ts, src/agent.ts) and a newer harness runtime (src/harness/) with durable lane-based operations.
Session persistence via Storage (memory or JSONL) with migration from legacy v3 JSONL, plus forking with branch-scoped value/list projection.
Harness operations are durable state machines (run, compaction, navigation) with retry policies, deferred execution, gate-based abort, and structural summaries.

pico3 (src/harness/pico3/) is a task-kind scheduler with kinds for generation, tool, post-tools, collapse, job, plugin; backed by MemoryStorage or JsonlStorage, with rewindable/sticky/session config and a chord view bridge.
File tools (read, write, edit, bash) with output capture/truncation, diff utilities, skills/prompt-template loading, and telemetry schemas (AI + harness spans).
